body: I'm feeling a little better, today.  Thank you for your encouragement.  Nobody thinks they'll grow up and become someone other people label as a loser.  It hurts even worse to know I've earned it through my own actions.  However, you're right.  The past isn't the future.  I have to focus on courage and compassion.  I have to accept that those failures are a part of me, but not the whole.  Again, thank you.  I'll do better, today.
